name: @supramark/markdown-native-rn
description: React Native native FFI wrapper for supramark-markdown — Markdown source to AST v2 JSON on iOS, macOS, Android, and Windows.

scripts.build: if command -v bob >/dev/null 2>&1 && node -e "process.exit(require('./package.json')['react-native-builder-bob']?0:1)"; then BROWSERSLIST_IGNORE_OLD_DATA=1 bob build; else echo 'react-native-builder-bob not configured; skipping build'; fi
scripts.prepack: node ../../../../scripts/verify-macos-native-packages.js --package-root . && if command -v bob >/dev/null 2>&1 && node -e "process.exit(require('./package.json')['react-native-builder-bob']?0:1)"; then BROWSERSLIST_IGNORE_OLD_DATA=1 bob build; fi
